title: Dogodent Toothpaste
passage: Do you sometimes wish that your much-loved pet smelled a little fresher? Well, you are not alone. Many pet owners complain that their animal friends don't smell too sweet. This is especially true of dog owners, who like to get up close and personal with their pet, but don't really enjoy the smell that comes out of their mouths. It's not your pet's fault, though. With all the meat they eat, it's no surprise that their mouth does not smell very nice. Now we have the answer. If you can't bear your dog's smell a moment longer, you need Dogodent toothpaste. Dogodent offers a total fix to your dog's mouth health. As well as making bad smells disappear, it will avoid mouth problems while making your dog's teeth white and bright. Dogodent has a taste that dogs love, so you and your pet will easily get into the habit of brushing twice a day. Send us a photo of your dog's winning smile, and you could win a year's supply of Dogodent, the world's best toothpaste for dogs. Home delivery available. $260 for one pot. Delivery charge: $50, or free delivery for orders over $1,000.
